items.title: Susanne un jour (D. Lupi)
items.desc: Didier Lupi Second, Susanne un jour, 1548. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
